outcome_definition: Outcome = assay-level analytical limit for a ddPCR probe assay, on a copies/uL scale, read as prose from the validation section. The LoD is defined by the authors as the lowest concentration at which >=9 positive partitions appeared in every replicate with >=10000 total partitions; rfbE met that criterion at a lower concentration. The working range is narrower than the LINEAR range because precision, not linearity, binds.
